How to play

Collect snacks to grow longer, and steer clear of the walls and your tail.

  • WASD works too

A helpful tip

Wide turns leave more room to keep moving safely.

Each snack adds 10 to your game score and 2 Pixel Points. Restart whenever you are ready for another round.

Use the arrow keys or WASD, or tap the direction controls on a touchscreen. Press Escape to pause.
